answer: Each agent identity mints by paying a compute-puzzle fee that grows quadratically: the n-th identity costs 100·n² GPU-minutes of proof-of-work. A Sybil attacker running 10 fakes burns ~33,000 GPU-minutes as the fee tide rises with each new mint. Attestations flow only through a randomly assigned vouching inlet of 5 established peers, and if an identity's behavior starts to wander from its vouchers' attested profile, half the quadratic fee pool is slashed.
